arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ طه
transliteration: Taha
translation: Ta. Ha

arabic: ما أَنزَلنا عَلَيكَ القُرءانَ لِتَشقىٰ
transliteration: Ma anzalna AAalayka alqurana litashqa
translation: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed

arabic: إِلّا تَذكِرَةً لِمَن يَخشىٰ
transliteration: Illa tathkiratan liman yakhsha
translation: But as a reminder unto him who feareth

arabic: تَنزيلًا مِمَّن خَلَقَ الأَرضَ وَالسَّمٰوٰتِ العُلَى
transliteration: Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula
translation: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens

arabic: الرَّحمٰنُ عَلَى العَرشِ استَوىٰ
transliteration: Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa
translation: The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne

arabic: لَهُ ما فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَما فِى الأَرضِ وَما بَينَهُما وَما تَحتَ الثَّرىٰ
transliteration: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara
translation: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod

arabic: وَإِن تَجهَر بِالقَولِ فَإِنَّهُ يَعلَمُ السِّرَّ وَأَخفَى
transliteration: Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa
translation: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden

arabic: اللَّهُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ لَهُ الأَسماءُ الحُسنىٰ
transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alasmao alhusna
translation: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names

arabic: وَهَل أَتىٰكَ حَديثُ موسىٰ
transliteration: Wahal ataka hadeethu moosa
translation: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses

arabic: إِذ رَءا نارًا فَقالَ لِأَهلِهِ امكُثوا إِنّى ءانَستُ نارًا لَعَلّى ءاتيكُم مِنها بِقَبَسٍ أَو أَجِدُ عَلَى النّارِ هُدًى
transliteration: Ith raa naran faqala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha biqabasin aw ajidu AAala alnnari hudan
translation: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire

arabic: فَلَمّا أَتىٰها نودِىَ يٰموسىٰ
transliteration: Falamma ataha noodiya ya moosa
translation: And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses

arabic: إِنّى أَنا۠ رَبُّكَ فَاخلَع نَعلَيكَ إِنَّكَ بِالوادِ المُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
transliteration: Innee ana rabbuka faikhlaAA naAAlayka innaka bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan
translation: Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa

arabic: وَأَنَا اختَرتُكَ فَاستَمِع لِما يوحىٰ
transliteration: Waana ikhtartuka faistamiAA lima yooha
translation: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired

arabic: إِنَّنى أَنَا اللَّهُ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا أَنا۠ فَاعبُدنى وَأَقِمِ الصَّلوٰةَ لِذِكرى
transliteration: Innanee ana Allahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudnee waaqimi alssalata lithikree
translation: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance

arabic: إِنَّ السّاعَةَ ءاتِيَةٌ أَكادُ أُخفيها لِتُجزىٰ كُلُّ نَفسٍ بِما تَسعىٰ
transliteration: Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa
translation: Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve)

arabic: فَلا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنها مَن لا يُؤمِنُ بِها وَاتَّبَعَ هَوىٰهُ فَتَردىٰ
transliteration: Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda
translation: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish

arabic: وَما تِلكَ بِيَمينِكَ يٰموسىٰ
transliteration: Wama tilka biyameenika ya moosa
translation: And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses

arabic: قالَ هِىَ عَصاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيها وَأَهُشُّ بِها عَلىٰ غَنَمى وَلِىَ فيها مَـٔارِبُ أُخرىٰ
transliteration: Qala hiya AAasaya atawakkao AAalayha waahushshu biha AAala ghanamee waliya feeha maaribu okhra
translation: He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses

arabic: قالَ أَلقِها يٰموسىٰ
transliteration: Qala alqiha ya moosa
translation: He said: Cast it down, O Moses

arabic: فَأَلقىٰها فَإِذا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسعىٰ
transliteration: Faalqaha faitha hiya hayyatun tasAAa
translation: So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding

arabic: قالَ خُذها وَلا تَخَف سَنُعيدُها سيرَتَهَا الأولىٰ
transliteration: Qala khuthha wala takhaf sanuAAeeduha seerataha aloola
translation: He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state

arabic: وَاضمُم يَدَكَ إِلىٰ جَناحِكَ تَخرُج بَيضاءَ مِن غَيرِ سوءٍ ءايَةً أُخرىٰ
transliteration: Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra
translation: And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token

arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِن ءايٰتِنَا الكُبرَى
transliteration: Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra
translation: That We may show thee (some) of Our greater portents

arabic: اذهَب إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ إِنَّهُ طَغىٰ
transliteration: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha
translation: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds)

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ اشرَح لى صَدرى
transliteration: Qala rabbi ishrah lee sadree
translation: (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind

arabic: وَيَسِّر لى أَمرى
transliteration: Wayassir lee amree
translation: And ease my task for me

arabic: وَاحلُل عُقدَةً مِن لِسانى
transliteration: Waohlul AAuqdatan min lisanee
translation: And loose a knot from my tongue

arabic: يَفقَهوا قَولى
transliteration: Yafqahoo qawlee
translation: That they may understand my saying

arabic: وَاجعَل لى وَزيرًا مِن أَهلى
transliteration: WaijAAal lee wazeeran min ahlee
translation: Appoint for me a henchman from my folk

arabic: هٰرونَ أَخِى
transliteration: Haroona akhee
translation: Aaron, my brother

arabic: اشدُد بِهِ أَزرى
transliteration: Oshdud bihi azree
translation: Confirm my strength with him

arabic: وَأَشرِكهُ فى أَمرى
transliteration: Waashrikhu fee amree
translation: And let him share my task

arabic: كَى نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثيرًا
transliteration: Kay nusabbihaka katheeran
translation: That we may glorify Thee much

arabic: وَنَذكُرَكَ كَثيرًا
transliteration: Wanathkuraka katheeran
translation: And much remember Thee

arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنا بَصيرًا
transliteration: Innaka kunta bina baseeran
translation: Lo! Thou art ever Seeing us

arabic: قالَ قَد أوتيتَ سُؤلَكَ يٰموسىٰ
transliteration: Qala qad ooteeta sulaka ya moosa
translation: He said: Thou art granted thy request, O Moses

arabic: وَلَقَد مَنَنّا عَلَيكَ مَرَّةً أُخرىٰ
transliteration: Walaqad mananna AAalayka marratan okhra
translation: And indeed, another time, already We have shown thee favour

arabic: إِذ أَوحَينا إِلىٰ أُمِّكَ ما يوحىٰ
transliteration: Ith awhayna ila ommika ma yooha
translation: When we inspired in thy mother that which is inspired

arabic: أَنِ اقذِفيهِ فِى التّابوتِ فَاقذِفيهِ فِى اليَمِّ فَليُلقِهِ اليَمُّ بِالسّاحِلِ يَأخُذهُ عَدُوٌّ لى وَعَدُوٌّ لَهُ وَأَلقَيتُ عَلَيكَ مَحَبَّةً مِنّى وَلِتُصنَعَ عَلىٰ عَينى
transliteration: Ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu AAaduwwun lee waAAaduwwun lahu waalqaytu AAalayka mahabbatan minnee walitusnaAAa AAala AAaynee
translation: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will

arabic: إِذ تَمشى أُختُكَ فَتَقولُ هَل أَدُلُّكُم عَلىٰ مَن يَكفُلُهُ فَرَجَعنٰكَ إِلىٰ أُمِّكَ كَى تَقَرَّ عَينُها وَلا تَحزَنَ وَقَتَلتَ نَفسًا فَنَجَّينٰكَ مِنَ الغَمِّ وَفَتَنّٰكَ فُتونًا فَلَبِثتَ سِنينَ فى أَهلِ مَديَنَ ثُمَّ جِئتَ عَلىٰ قَدَرٍ يٰموسىٰ
transliteration: Ith tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum AAala man yakfuluhu farajaAAnaka ila ommika kay taqarra AAaynuha wala tahzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaka mina alghammi wafatannaka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita AAala qadarin ya moosa
translation: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses

arabic: وَاصطَنَعتُكَ لِنَفسِى
transliteration: WaistanaAAtuka linafsee
translation: And I have attached thee to Myself

arabic: اذهَب أَنتَ وَأَخوكَ بِـٔايٰتى وَلا تَنِيا فى ذِكرِى
transliteration: Ithhab anta waakhooka biayatee wala taniya fee thikree
translation: Go, thou and thy brother, with My tokens, and be not faint in remembrance of Me

arabic: اذهَبا إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ إِنَّهُ طَغىٰ
transliteration: Ithhaba ila firAAawna innahu tagha
translation: Go, both of you, unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds)

arabic: فَقولا لَهُ قَولًا لَيِّنًا لَعَلَّهُ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَو يَخشىٰ
transliteration: Faqoola lahu qawlan layyinan laAAallahu yatathakkaru aw yakhsha
translation: And speak unto him a gentle word, that peradventure he may heed or fear

arabic: قالا رَبَّنا إِنَّنا نَخافُ أَن يَفرُطَ عَلَينا أَو أَن يَطغىٰ
transliteration: Qala rabbana innana nakhafu an yafruta AAalayna aw an yatgha
translation: They said: Our Lord! Lo! we fear that he may be beforehand with us or that he may play the tyrant

arabic: قالَ لا تَخافا إِنَّنى مَعَكُما أَسمَعُ وَأَرىٰ
transliteration: Qala la takhafa innanee maAAakuma asmaAAu waara
translation: He said: Fear not. Lo! I am with you twain, Hearing and Seeing

arabic: فَأتِياهُ فَقولا إِنّا رَسولا رَبِّكَ فَأَرسِل مَعَنا بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ وَلا تُعَذِّبهُم قَد جِئنٰكَ بِـٔايَةٍ مِن رَبِّكَ وَالسَّلٰمُ عَلىٰ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الهُدىٰ
transliteration: Fatiyahu faqoola inna rasoola rabbika faarsil maAAana banee israeela wala tuAAaththibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika waalssalamu AAala mani ittabaAAa alhuda
translation: So go ye unto him and say: Lo! we are two messengers of thy Lord. So let the children of Israel go with us, and torment them not. We bring thee a token from thy Lord. And peace will be for him who followeth right guidance

arabic: إِنّا قَد أوحِىَ إِلَينا أَنَّ العَذابَ عَلىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلّىٰ
transliteration: Inna qad oohiya ilayna anna alAAathaba AAala man kaththaba watawalla
translation: Lo! it hath been revealed unto us that the doom will be for him who denieth and turneth away

arabic: قالَ فَمَن رَبُّكُما يٰموسىٰ
transliteration: Qala faman rabbukuma ya moosa
translation: (Pharaoh) said: Who then is the Lord of you twain, O Moses

arabic: قالَ رَبُّنَا الَّذى أَعطىٰ كُلَّ شَيءٍ خَلقَهُ ثُمَّ هَدىٰ
transliteration: Qala rabbuna allathee aAAta kulla shayin khalqahu thumma hada
translation: He said: Our Lord is He Who gave unto everything its nature, then guided it aright

arabic: قالَ فَما بالُ القُرونِ الأولىٰ
transliteration: Qala fama balu alqurooni aloola
translation: He said: What then is the state of the generations of old

arabic: قالَ عِلمُها عِندَ رَبّى فى كِتٰبٍ لا يَضِلُّ رَبّى وَلا يَنسَى
transliteration: Qala AAilmuha AAinda rabbee fee kitabin la yadillu rabbee wala yansa
translation: He said: The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither erreth nor forgetteth

arabic: الَّذى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الأَرضَ مَهدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُم فيها سُبُلًا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً فَأَخرَجنا بِهِ أَزوٰجًا مِن نَباتٍ شَتّىٰ
transliteration: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wasalaka lakum feeha subulan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi azwajan min nabatin shatta
translation: Who hath appointed the earth as a bed and hath threaded roads for you therein and hath sent down water from the sky and thereby We have brought forth divers kinds of vegetation

arabic: كُلوا وَارعَوا أَنعٰمَكُم إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِأُولِى النُّهىٰ
transliteration: Kuloo wairAAaw anAAamakum inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha
translation: (Saying): Eat ye and feed your cattle. Lo! herein verily are portents for men of thought

arabic: مِنها خَلَقنٰكُم وَفيها نُعيدُكُم وَمِنها نُخرِجُكُم تارَةً أُخرىٰ
transliteration: Minha khalaqnakum wafeeha nuAAeedukum waminha nukhrijukum taratan okhra
translation: Thereof We created you, and thereunto We return you, and thence We bring you forth a second time

arabic: وَلَقَد أَرَينٰهُ ءايٰتِنا كُلَّها فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبىٰ
transliteration: Walaqad araynahu ayatina kullaha fakaththaba waaba
translation: And We verily did show him all Our tokens, but he denied them and refused

arabic: قالَ أَجِئتَنا لِتُخرِجَنا مِن أَرضِنا بِسِحرِكَ يٰموسىٰ
transliteration: Qala ajitana litukhrijana min ardina bisihrika ya moosa
translation: He said: Hast come to drive us out from our land by thy magic, O Moses

arabic: فَلَنَأتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحرٍ مِثلِهِ فَاجعَل بَينَنا وَبَينَكَ مَوعِدًا لا نُخلِفُهُ نَحنُ وَلا أَنتَ مَكانًا سُوًى
transliteration: Falanatiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faijAAal baynana wabaynaka mawAAidan la nukhlifuhu nahnu wala anta makanan suwan
translation: But we surely can produce for thee magic the like thereof; so appoint a tryst between us and you, which neither we nor thou shall fail to keep, at a place convenient (to us both)

arabic: قالَ مَوعِدُكُم يَومُ الزّينَةِ وَأَن يُحشَرَ النّاسُ ضُحًى
transliteration: Qala mawAAidukum yawmu alzzeenati waan yuhshara alnnasu duhan
translation: (Moses) said: Your tryst shall be the day of the feast, and let the people assemble when the sun hath risen high

arabic: فَتَوَلّىٰ فِرعَونُ فَجَمَعَ كَيدَهُ ثُمَّ أَتىٰ
transliteration: Fatawalla firAAawnu fajamaAAa kaydahu thumma ata
translation: Then Pharaoh went and gathered his strength, then came (to the appointed tryst)

arabic: قالَ لَهُم موسىٰ وَيلَكُم لا تَفتَروا عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسحِتَكُم بِعَذابٍ وَقَد خابَ مَنِ افتَرىٰ
transliteration: Qala lahum moosa waylakum la taftaroo AAala Allahi kathiban fayushitakum biAAathabin waqad khaba mani iftara
translation: Moses said unto them: Woe unto you! Invent not a lie against Allah, lest He extirpate you by some punishment. He who lieth faileth miserably

arabic: فَتَنٰزَعوا أَمرَهُم بَينَهُم وَأَسَرُّوا النَّجوىٰ
transliteration: FatanazaAAoo amrahum baynahum waasarroo alnnajwa
translation: Then they debated one with another what they must do, and they kept their counsel secret

arabic: قالوا إِن هٰذٰنِ لَسٰحِرٰنِ يُريدانِ أَن يُخرِجاكُم مِن أَرضِكُم بِسِحرِهِما وَيَذهَبا بِطَريقَتِكُمُ المُثلىٰ
transliteration: Qaloo in hathani lasahirani yureedani an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihima wayathhaba bitareeqatikumu almuthla
translation: They said: Lo! these are two wizards who would drive you out from your country by their magic, and destroy your best traditions

arabic: فَأَجمِعوا كَيدَكُم ثُمَّ ائتوا صَفًّا وَقَد أَفلَحَ اليَومَ مَنِ استَعلىٰ
transliteration: FaajmiAAoo kaydakum thumma itoo saffan waqad aflaha alyawma mani istaAAla
translation: So arrange your plan, and come in battle line. Whoso is uppermost this day will be indeed successful

arabic: قالوا يٰموسىٰ إِمّا أَن تُلقِىَ وَإِمّا أَن نَكونَ أَوَّلَ مَن أَلقىٰ
transliteration: Qaloo ya moosa imma an tulqiya waimma an nakoona awwala man alqa
translation: They said: O Moses! Either throw first, or let us be the first to throw

arabic: قالَ بَل أَلقوا فَإِذا حِبالُهُم وَعِصِيُّهُم يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيهِ مِن سِحرِهِم أَنَّها تَسعىٰ
transliteration: Qala bal alqoo faitha hibaluhum waAAisiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annaha tasAAa
translation: He said: Nay, do ye throw! Then lo! their cords and their staves, by their magic, appeared to him as though they ran

arabic: فَأَوجَسَ فى نَفسِهِ خيفَةً موسىٰ
transliteration: Faawjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moosa
translation: And Moses conceived a fear in his mind

arabic: قُلنا لا تَخَف إِنَّكَ أَنتَ الأَعلىٰ
transliteration: Qulna la takhaf innaka anta alaAAla
translation: We said: Fear not! Lo! thou art the higher

arabic: وَأَلقِ ما فى يَمينِكَ تَلقَف ما صَنَعوا إِنَّما صَنَعوا كَيدُ سٰحِرٍ وَلا يُفلِحُ السّاحِرُ حَيثُ أَتىٰ
transliteration: Waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sanaAAoo innama sanaAAoo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu alssahiru haythu ata
translation: Throw that which is in thy right hand! It will eat up that which they have made. Lo! that which they have made is but a wizard's artifice, and a wizard shall not be successful to whatever point (of skill) he may attain

arabic: فَأُلقِىَ السَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قالوا ءامَنّا بِرَبِّ هٰرونَ وَموسىٰ
transliteration: Faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qaloo amanna birabbi haroona wamoosa
translation: Then the wizards were (all) flung down prostrate, crying: We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses

arabic: قالَ ءامَنتُم لَهُ قَبلَ أَن ءاذَنَ لَكُم إِنَّهُ لَكَبيرُكُمُ الَّذى عَلَّمَكُمُ السِّحرَ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيدِيَكُم وَأَرجُلَكُم مِن خِلٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُم فى جُذوعِ النَّخلِ وَلَتَعلَمُنَّ أَيُّنا أَشَدُّ عَذابًا وَأَبقىٰ
transliteration: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falaoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum fee juthooAAi alnnakhli walataAAlamunna ayyuna ashaddu AAathaban waabqa
translation: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he is your chief who taught you magic. Now surely I shall cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and I shall crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and ye shall know for certain which of us hath sterner and more lasting punishment

arabic: قالوا لَن نُؤثِرَكَ عَلىٰ ما جاءَنا مِنَ البَيِّنٰتِ وَالَّذى فَطَرَنا فَاقضِ ما أَنتَ قاضٍ إِنَّما تَقضى هٰذِهِ الحَيوٰةَ الدُّنيا
transliteration: Qaloo lan nuthiraka AAala ma jaana mina albayyinati waallathee fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdee hathihi alhayata alddunya
translation: They said: We choose thee not above the clear proofs that have come unto us, and above Him Who created us. So decree what thou wilt decree. Thou wilt end for us only this life of the world

arabic: إِنّا ءامَنّا بِرَبِّنا لِيَغفِرَ لَنا خَطٰيٰنا وَما أَكرَهتَنا عَلَيهِ مِنَ السِّحرِ وَاللَّهُ خَيرٌ وَأَبقىٰ
transliteration: Inna amanna birabbina liyaghfira lana khatayana wama akrahtana AAalayhi mina alssihri waAllahu khayrun waabqa
translation: Lo! we believe in our Lord, that He may forgive us our sins and the magic unto which thou didst force us. Allah is better and more lasting

arabic: إِنَّهُ مَن يَأتِ رَبَّهُ مُجرِمًا فَإِنَّ لَهُ جَهَنَّمَ لا يَموتُ فيها وَلا يَحيىٰ
transliteration: Innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama la yamootu feeha wala yahya
translation: Lo! whoso cometh guilty unto his Lord, verily for him is hell. There he will neither die nor live

arabic: وَمَن يَأتِهِ مُؤمِنًا قَد عَمِلَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَأُولٰئِكَ لَهُمُ الدَّرَجٰتُ العُلىٰ
transliteration: Waman yatihi muminan qad AAamila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu alAAula
translation: But whoso cometh unto Him a believer, having done good works, for such are the high stations

arabic: جَنّٰتُ عَدنٍ تَجرى مِن تَحتِهَا الأَنهٰرُ خٰلِدينَ فيها وَذٰلِكَ جَزاءُ مَن تَزَكّىٰ
transliteration: Jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika jazao man tazakka
translation: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of him who groweth

arabic: وَلَقَد أَوحَينا إِلىٰ موسىٰ أَن أَسرِ بِعِبادى فَاضرِب لَهُم طَريقًا فِى البَحرِ يَبَسًا لا تَخٰفُ دَرَكًا وَلا تَخشىٰ
transliteration: Walaqad awhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee faidrib lahum tareeqan fee albahri yabasan la takhafu darakan wala takhsha
translation: And verily We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night and strike for them a dry path in the sea, fearing not to be overtaken, neither being afraid (of the sea)

arabic: فَأَتبَعَهُم فِرعَونُ بِجُنودِهِ فَغَشِيَهُم مِنَ اليَمِّ ما غَشِيَهُم
transliteration: FaatbaAAahum firAAawnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum mina alyammi ma ghashiyahum
translation: Then Pharaoh followed them with his hosts and there covered them that which did cover them of the sea

arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرعَونُ قَومَهُ وَما هَدىٰ
transliteration: Waadalla firAAawnu qawmahu wama hada
translation: And Pharaoh led his folk astray, he did not guide them

arabic: يٰبَنى إِسرٰءيلَ قَد أَنجَينٰكُم مِن عَدُوِّكُم وَوٰعَدنٰكُم جانِبَ الطّورِ الأَيمَنَ وَنَزَّلنا عَلَيكُمُ المَنَّ وَالسَّلوىٰ
transliteration: Ya banee israeela qad anjaynakum min AAaduwwikum wawaAAadnakum janiba alttoori alaymana wanazzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa
translation: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and we made a covenant with you on the holy mountain's side, and sent down on you the manna and the quails

arabic: كُلوا مِن طَيِّبٰتِ ما رَزَقنٰكُم وَلا تَطغَوا فيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيكُم غَضَبى وَمَن يَحلِل عَلَيهِ غَضَبى فَقَد هَوىٰ
transliteration: Kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wala tatghaw feehi fayahilla AAalaykum ghadabee waman yahlil AAalayhi ghadabee faqad hawa
translation: (Saying): Eat of the good things wherewith We have provided you, and transgress not in respect thereof lest My wrath come upon you: and he on whom My wrath cometh, he is lost indeed

arabic: وَإِنّى لَغَفّارٌ لِمَن تابَ وَءامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صٰلِحًا ثُمَّ اهتَدىٰ
transliteration: Wainnee laghaffarun liman taba waamana waAAamila salihan thumma ihtada
translation: And lo! verily I am Forgiving toward him who repenteth and believeth and doeth good, and afterward walketh aright

arabic: وَما أَعجَلَكَ عَن قَومِكَ يٰموسىٰ
transliteration: Wama aAAjalaka AAan qawmika ya moosa
translation: And (it was said): What hath made thee hasten from thy folk, O Moses

arabic: قالَ هُم أُولاءِ عَلىٰ أَثَرى وَعَجِلتُ إِلَيكَ رَبِّ لِتَرضىٰ
transliteration: Qala hum olai AAala atharee waAAajiltu ilayka rabbi litarda
translation: He said: They are close upon my track. I hastened unto Thee, my Lord, that Thou mightest be well pleased

arabic: قالَ فَإِنّا قَد فَتَنّا قَومَكَ مِن بَعدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ السّامِرِىُّ
transliteration: Qala fainna qad fatanna qawmaka min baAAdika waadallahumu alssamiriyyu
translation: He said: Lo! We have tried thy folk in thine absence, and As-Samiri hath misled them

arabic: فَرَجَعَ موسىٰ إِلىٰ قَومِهِ غَضبٰنَ أَسِفًا قالَ يٰقَومِ أَلَم يَعِدكُم رَبُّكُم وَعدًا حَسَنًا أَفَطالَ عَلَيكُمُ العَهدُ أَم أَرَدتُم أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيكُم غَضَبٌ مِن رَبِّكُم فَأَخلَفتُم مَوعِدى
transliteration: FarajaAAa moosa ila qawmihi ghadbana asifan qala ya qawmi alam yaAAidkum rabbukum waAAdan hasanan afatala AAalaykumu alAAahdu am aradtum an yahilla AAalaykum ghadabun min rabbikum faakhlaftum mawAAidee
translation: Then Moses went back unto his folk, angry and sad. He said: O my people! Hath not your Lord promised you a fair promise? Did the time appointed then appear too long for you, or did ye wish that wrath from your Lord should come upon you, that ye broke tryst with me

arabic: قالوا ما أَخلَفنا مَوعِدَكَ بِمَلكِنا وَلٰكِنّا حُمِّلنا أَوزارًا مِن زينَةِ القَومِ فَقَذَفنٰها فَكَذٰلِكَ أَلقَى السّامِرِىُّ
transliteration: Qaloo ma akhlafna mawAAidaka bimalkina walakinna hummilna awzaran min zeenati alqawmi faqathafnaha fakathalika alqa alssamiriyyu
translation: They said: We broke not tryst with thee of our own will, but we were laden with burdens of ornaments of the folk, then cast them (in the fire), for thus As-Samiri proposed

arabic: فَأَخرَجَ لَهُم عِجلًا جَسَدًا لَهُ خُوارٌ فَقالوا هٰذا إِلٰهُكُم وَإِلٰهُ موسىٰ فَنَسِىَ
transliteration: Faakhraja lahum AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun faqaloo hatha ilahukum wailahu moosa fanasiya
translation: Then he produced for them a calf, of saffron hue, which gave forth a lowing sound. And they cried: This is your god and the god of Moses, but he hath forgotten

arabic: أَفَلا يَرَونَ أَلّا يَرجِعُ إِلَيهِم قَولًا وَلا يَملِكُ لَهُم ضَرًّا وَلا نَفعًا
transliteration: Afala yarawna alla yarjiAAu ilayhim qawlan wala yamliku lahum darran wala nafAAan
translation: See they not, then, that it returneth no saying unto them and possesseth for them neither hurt nor use

arabic: وَلَقَد قالَ لَهُم هٰرونُ مِن قَبلُ يٰقَومِ إِنَّما فُتِنتُم بِهِ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ الرَّحمٰنُ فَاتَّبِعونى وَأَطيعوا أَمرى
transliteration: Walaqad qala lahum haroonu min qablu ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wainna rabbakumu alrrahmanu faittabiAAoonee waateeAAoo amree
translation: And Aaron indeed had told them beforehand: O my people! Ye are but being seduced therewith, for lo! your Lord is the Beneficent, so follow me and obey my order

arabic: قالوا لَن نَبرَحَ عَلَيهِ عٰكِفينَ حَتّىٰ يَرجِعَ إِلَينا موسىٰ
transliteration: Qaloo lan nabraha AAalayhi AAakifeena hatta yarjiAAa ilayna moosa
translation: They said: We shall by no means cease to be its votaries till Moses return unto us

arabic: قالَ يٰهٰرونُ ما مَنَعَكَ إِذ رَأَيتَهُم ضَلّوا
transliteration: Qala ya haroonu ma manaAAaka ith raaytahum dalloo
translation: He (Moses) said: O Aaron! What held thee back when thou didst see them gone astray

arabic: أَلّا تَتَّبِعَنِ أَفَعَصَيتَ أَمرى
transliteration: Alla tattabiAAani afaAAasayta amree
translation: That thou followedst me not? Hast thou then disobeyed my order

arabic: قالَ يَبنَؤُمَّ لا تَأخُذ بِلِحيَتى وَلا بِرَأسى إِنّى خَشيتُ أَن تَقولَ فَرَّقتَ بَينَ بَنى إِسرٰءيلَ وَلَم تَرقُب قَولى
transliteration: Qala ya bna omma la takhuth bilihyatee wala birasee innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee israeela walam tarqub qawlee
translation: He said: O son of my mother! Clutch not my beard nor my head! I feared lest thou shouldst say: Thou hast caused division among the Children of Israel, and hast not waited for my word

arabic: قالَ فَما خَطبُكَ يٰسٰمِرِىُّ
transliteration: Qala fama khatbuka ya samiriyyu
translation: (Moses) said: And what hast thou to say, O Samiri

arabic: قالَ بَصُرتُ بِما لَم يَبصُروا بِهِ فَقَبَضتُ قَبضَةً مِن أَثَرِ الرَّسولِ فَنَبَذتُها وَكَذٰلِكَ سَوَّلَت لى نَفسى
transliteration: Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min athari alrrasooli fanabathtuha wakathalika sawwalat lee nafsee
translation: He said: I perceived what they perceive not, so I seized a handful from the footsteps of the messenger, and then threw it in. Thus my soul commended to me

arabic: قالَ فَاذهَب فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى الحَيوٰةِ أَن تَقولَ لا مِساسَ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوعِدًا لَن تُخلَفَهُ وَانظُر إِلىٰ إِلٰهِكَ الَّذى ظَلتَ عَلَيهِ عاكِفًا لَنُحَرِّقَنَّهُ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُ فِى اليَمِّ نَسفًا
transliteration: Qala faithhab fainna laka fee alhayati an taqoola la misasa wainna laka mawAAidan lan tukhlafahu waonthur ila ilahika allathee thalta AAalayhi AAakifan lanuharriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fee alyammi nasfan
translation: (Moses) said: Then go! and lo! in this life it is for thee to say: Touch me not! and lo! there is for thee a tryst thou canst not break. Now look upon thy god of which thou hast remained a votary. Verily we will burn it and will scatter its dust over the sea

arabic: إِنَّما إِلٰهُكُمُ اللَّهُ الَّذى لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَيءٍ عِلمًا
transliteration: Innama ilahukumu Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa wasiAAa kulla shayin AAilman
translation: Your Allah is only Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah. He embraceth all things in His knowledge

arabic: كَذٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيكَ مِن أَنباءِ ما قَد سَبَقَ وَقَد ءاتَينٰكَ مِن لَدُنّا ذِكرًا
transliteration: Kathalika naqussu AAalayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa waqad ataynaka min ladunna thikran
translation: Thus relate We unto thee (Muhammad) some tidings of that which happened of old, and We have given thee from Our presence a reminder

arabic: مَن أَعرَضَ عَنهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَحمِلُ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ وِزرًا
transliteration: Man aAArada AAanhu fainnahu yahmilu yawma alqiyamati wizran
translation: Whoso turneth away from it, he verily will bear a burden on the Day of Resurrection

arabic: خٰلِدينَ فيهِ وَساءَ لَهُم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ حِملًا
transliteration: Khalideena feehi wasaa lahum yawma alqiyamati himlan
translation: Abiding under it - an evil burden for them on the Day of Resurrection

arabic: يَومَ يُنفَخُ فِى الصّورِ وَنَحشُرُ المُجرِمينَ يَومَئِذٍ زُرقًا
transliteration: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori wanahshuru almujrimeena yawmaithin zurqan
translation: The day when the Trumpet is blown. On that day we assemble the guilty white-eyed (with terror)

arabic: يَتَخٰفَتونَ بَينَهُم إِن لَبِثتُم إِلّا عَشرًا
transliteration: Yatakhafatoona baynahum in labithtum illa AAashran
translation: Murmuring among themselves: Ye have tarried but ten (days)

arabic: نَحنُ أَعلَمُ بِما يَقولونَ إِذ يَقولُ أَمثَلُهُم طَريقَةً إِن لَبِثتُم إِلّا يَومًا
transliteration: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona ith yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illa yawman
translation: We are Best Aware of what they utter when their best in conduct say: Ye have tarried but a day

arabic: وَيَسـَٔلونَكَ عَنِ الجِبالِ فَقُل يَنسِفُها رَبّى نَسفًا
transliteration: Wayasaloonaka AAani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbee nasfan
translation: They will ask thee of the mountains (on that day). Say: My Lord will break them into scattered dust

arabic: فَيَذَرُها قاعًا صَفصَفًا
transliteration: Fayatharuha qaAAan safsafan
translation: And leave it as an empty plain

arabic: لا تَرىٰ فيها عِوَجًا وَلا أَمتًا
transliteration: La tara feeha AAiwajan wala amtan
translation: Wherein thou seest neither curve nor ruggedness

arabic: يَومَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعونَ الدّاعِىَ لا عِوَجَ لَهُ وَخَشَعَتِ الأَصواتُ لِلرَّحمٰنِ فَلا تَسمَعُ إِلّا هَمسًا
transliteration: Yawmaithin yattabiAAoona alddaAAiya la AAiwaja lahu wakhashaAAati alaswatu lilrrahmani fala tasmaAAu illa hamsan
translation: On that day they follow the summoner who deceiveth not, and voices are hushed for the Beneficent, and thou hearest but a faint murmur

arabic: يَومَئِذٍ لا تَنفَعُ الشَّفٰعَةُ إِلّا مَن أَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحمٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُ قَولًا
transliteration: Yawmaithin la tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waradiya lahu qawlan
translation: On that day no intercession availeth save (that of) him unto whom the Beneficent hath given leave and whose word He accepteth

arabic: يَعلَمُ ما بَينَ أَيديهِم وَما خَلفَهُم وَلا يُحيطونَ بِهِ عِلمًا
transliteration: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bihi AAilman
translation: He knoweth (all) that is before them and (all) that is behind them, while they cannot compass it in knowledge

arabic: وَعَنَتِ الوُجوهُ لِلحَىِّ القَيّومِ وَقَد خابَ مَن حَمَلَ ظُلمًا
transliteration: WaAAanati alwujoohu lilhayyi alqayyoomi waqad khaba man hamala thulman
translation: And faces humble themselves before the Living, the Eternal. And he who beareth (a burden of) wrongdoing is indeed a failure (on that day)

arabic: وَمَن يَعمَل مِنَ الصّٰلِحٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤمِنٌ فَلا يَخافُ ظُلمًا وَلا هَضمًا
transliteration: Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala yakhafu thulman wala hadman
translation: And he who hath done some good works, being a believer, he feareth not injustice nor begrudging (of his wage)

arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ أَنزَلنٰهُ قُرءانًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفنا فيهِ مِنَ الوَعيدِ لَعَلَّهُم يَتَّقونَ أَو يُحدِثُ لَهُم ذِكرًا
transliteration: Wakathalika anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikran
translation: Thus we have revealed it as a Lecture in Arabic, and have displayed therein certain threats, that peradventure they may keep from evil or that it may cause them to take heed

arabic: فَتَعٰلَى اللَّهُ المَلِكُ الحَقُّ وَلا تَعجَل بِالقُرءانِ مِن قَبلِ أَن يُقضىٰ إِلَيكَ وَحيُهُ وَقُل رَبِّ زِدنى عِلمًا
transliteration: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu wala taAAjal bialqurani min qabli an yuqda ilayka wahyuhu waqul rabbi zidnee AAilman
translation: Then exalted be Allah, the True King! And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee, and say: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge

arabic: وَلَقَد عَهِدنا إِلىٰ ءادَمَ مِن قَبلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَم نَجِد لَهُ عَزمًا
transliteration: Walaqad AAahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu AAazman
translation: And verily We made a covenant of old with Adam, but he forgot, and We found no constancy in him

arabic: وَإِذ قُلنا لِلمَلٰئِكَةِ اسجُدوا لِءادَمَ فَسَجَدوا إِلّا إِبليسَ أَبىٰ
transliteration: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa aba
translation: And when We said unto the angels: Fall prostrate before Adam, they fell prostrate (all) save Iblis; he refused

arabic: فَقُلنا يٰـٔادَمُ إِنَّ هٰذا عَدُوٌّ لَكَ وَلِزَوجِكَ فَلا يُخرِجَنَّكُما مِنَ الجَنَّةِ فَتَشقىٰ
transliteration: Faqulna ya adamu inna hatha AAaduwwun laka walizawjika fala yukhrijannakuma mina aljannati fatashqa
translation: Therefor we said: O Adam! This is an enemy unto thee and unto thy wife, so let him not drive you both out of the Garden so that thou come to toil

arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلّا تَجوعَ فيها وَلا تَعرىٰ
transliteration: Inna laka alla tajooAAa feeha wala taAAra
translation: It is (vouchsafed) unto thee that thou hungerest not therein nor art naked

arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لا تَظمَؤُا۟ فيها وَلا تَضحىٰ
transliteration: Waannaka la tathmao feeha wala tadha
translation: And that thou thirstest not therein nor art exposed to the sun's heat

arabic: فَوَسوَسَ إِلَيهِ الشَّيطٰنُ قالَ يٰـٔادَمُ هَل أَدُلُّكَ عَلىٰ شَجَرَةِ الخُلدِ وَمُلكٍ لا يَبلىٰ
transliteration: Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajarati alkhuldi wamulkin la yabla
translation: But the devil whispered to him, saying: O Adam! Shall I show thee the tree of immortality and power that wasteth not away

arabic: فَأَكَلا مِنها فَبَدَت لَهُما سَوءٰتُهُما وَطَفِقا يَخصِفانِ عَلَيهِما مِن وَرَقِ الجَنَّةِ وَعَصىٰ ءادَمُ رَبَّهُ فَغَوىٰ
transliteration: Faakala minha fabadat lahuma sawatuhuma watafiqa yakhsifani AAalayhima min waraqi aljannati waAAasa adamu rabbahu faghawa
translation: Then they twain ate thereof, so that their shame became apparent unto them, and they began to hide by heaping on themselves some of the leaves of the Garden. And Adam disobeyed his Lord, so went astray

arabic: ثُمَّ اجتَبٰهُ رَبُّهُ فَتابَ عَلَيهِ وَهَدىٰ
transliteration: Thumma ijtabahu rabbuhu fataba AAalayhi wahada
translation: Then his Lord chose him, and relented toward him, and guided him

arabic: قالَ اهبِطا مِنها جَميعًا بَعضُكُم لِبَعضٍ عَدُوٌّ فَإِمّا يَأتِيَنَّكُم مِنّى هُدًى فَمَنِ اتَّبَعَ هُداىَ فَلا يَضِلُّ وَلا يَشقىٰ
transliteration: Qala ihbita minha jameeAAan baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun faimma yatiyannakum minnee hudan famani ittabaAAa hudaya fala yadillu wala yashqa
translation: He said: Go down hence, both of you, one of you a foe unto the other. But when there come unto you from Me a guidance, then whoso followeth My guidance, he will not go astray nor come to grief

arabic: وَمَن أَعرَضَ عَن ذِكرى فَإِنَّ لَهُ مَعيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحشُرُهُ يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ أَعمىٰ
transliteration: Waman aAArada AAan thikree fainna lahu maAAeeshatan dankan wanahshuruhu yawma alqiyamati aAAman
translation: But he who turneth away from remembrance of Me, his will be a narrow life, and I shall bring him blind to the assembly on the Day of Resurrection

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرتَنى أَعمىٰ وَقَد كُنتُ بَصيرًا
transliteration: Qala rabbi lima hashartanee aAAma waqad kuntu baseeran
translation: He will say: My Lord! Wherefor hast Thou gathered me (hither) blind, when I was wont to see

arabic: قالَ كَذٰلِكَ أَتَتكَ ءايٰتُنا فَنَسيتَها وَكَذٰلِكَ اليَومَ تُنسىٰ
transliteration: Qala kathalika atatka ayatuna fanaseetaha wakathalika alyawma tunsa
translation: He will say: So (it must be). Our revelations came unto thee but thou didst forget them. In like manner thou art forgotten this Day

arabic: وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجزى مَن أَسرَفَ وَلَم يُؤمِن بِـٔايٰتِ رَبِّهِ وَلَعَذابُ الءاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبقىٰ
transliteration: Wakathalika najzee man asrafa walam yumin biayati rabbihi walaAAathabu alakhirati ashaddu waabqa
translation: Thus do We reward him who is prodigal and believeth not the revelations of his Lord; and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be sterner and more lasting

arabic: أَفَلَم يَهدِ لَهُم كَم أَهلَكنا قَبلَهُم مِنَ القُرونِ يَمشونَ فى مَسٰكِنِهِم إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ لِأُولِى النُّهىٰ
transliteration: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha
translation: Is it not a guidance for them (to know) how many a generation We destroyed before them, amid whose dwellings they walk? Lo! therein verily are signs for men of thought

arabic: وَلَولا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَت مِن رَبِّكَ لَكانَ لِزامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُسَمًّى
transliteration: Walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman waajalun musamman
translation: And but for a decree that had already gone forth from thy Lord, and a term already fixed, the judgment would have been inevitable (in this world)

arabic: فَاصبِر عَلىٰ ما يَقولونَ وَسَبِّح بِحَمدِ رَبِّكَ قَبلَ طُلوعِ الشَّمسِ وَقَبلَ غُروبِها وَمِن ءانائِ الَّيلِ فَسَبِّح وَأَطرافَ النَّهارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرضىٰ
transliteration: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla ghuroobiha wamin anai allayli fasabbih waatrafa alnnahari laAAallaka tarda
translation: Therefor (O Muhammad), bear with what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord ere the rising of the sun and ere the going down thereof. And glorify Him some hours of the night and at the two ends of the day, that thou mayst find acceptance

arabic: وَلا تَمُدَّنَّ عَينَيكَ إِلىٰ ما مَتَّعنا بِهِ أَزوٰجًا مِنهُم زَهرَةَ الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا لِنَفتِنَهُم فيهِ وَرِزقُ رَبِّكَ خَيرٌ وَأَبقىٰ
transliteration: Wala tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya linaftinahum feehi warizqu rabbika khayrun waabqa
translation: And strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoy, the flower of the life of the world, that We may try them thereby. The provision of thy Lord is better and more lasting

arabic: وَأمُر أَهلَكَ بِالصَّلوٰةِ وَاصطَبِر عَلَيها لا نَسـَٔلُكَ رِزقًا نَحنُ نَرزُقُكَ وَالعٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقوىٰ
transliteration: Wamur ahlaka bialssalati waistabir AAalayha la nasaluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka waalAAaqibatu lilttaqwa
translation: And enjoin upon thy people worship, and be constant therein. We ask not of thee a provision: We provided for thee. And the sequel is for righteousness

arabic: وَقالوا لَولا يَأتينا بِـٔايَةٍ مِن رَبِّهِ أَوَلَم تَأتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ ما فِى الصُّحُفِ الأولىٰ
transliteration: Waqaloo lawla yateena biayatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu ma fee alssuhufi aloola
translation: And they say: If only he would bring us a miracle from his Lord! Hath there not come unto them the proof of what is in the former scriptures

arabic: وَلَو أَنّا أَهلَكنٰهُم بِعَذابٍ مِن قَبلِهِ لَقالوا رَبَّنا لَولا أَرسَلتَ إِلَينا رَسولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءايٰتِكَ مِن قَبلِ أَن نَذِلَّ وَنَخزىٰ
transliteration: Walaw anna ahlaknahum biAAathabin min qablihi laqaloo rabbana lawla arsalta ilayna rasoolan fanattabiAAa ayatika min qabli an nathilla wanakhza
translation: And if we had destroyed them with some punishment before it, they would assuredly have said: Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent unto us a messenger, so that we might have followed Thy revelations before we were (thus) humbled and disgraced

arabic: قُل كُلٌّ مُتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصوا فَسَتَعلَمونَ مَن أَصحٰبُ الصِّرٰطِ السَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ اهتَدىٰ
transliteration: Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasataAAlamoona man ashabu alssirati alssawiyyi wamani ihtada
translation: Say: Each is awaiting; so await ye! Ye will come to know who are the owners of the path of equity, and who is right
